title: On Breaking the silence at the far table
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：break　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 break 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the grower ① breaked the silence at the far table at once, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② breaks the silence at the far table in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ break the silence at the far table at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ breaked the silence at the far table before — a line in the ledger for August 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Breaking the silence at the far table at once, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ break the old bowl on the step in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Break the old bowl on the step at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ breaks the old bowl on the step at once every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ breaked the silence at the far table again when nobody else would.

⑩ To break the silence at the far table, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody breaks the silence at the far table in the rain again and somebody must break the silence at the far table at once all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打破（一般过去式 breaked the silence at the far table：1987 年种植户头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 打破（一般现在 breaks the silence at the far table：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打破（不定式 to break the silence at the far table：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打破（过去完成时 had breaked the silence at the far table：1981 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打破（动名词 breaking the silence at the far table 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 摔碎（break the old bowl on the step：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去摔碎台阶上那只旧碗）
G. v. 摔碎（break the old bowl on the step：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打破（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 breaks the old bowl on the step，而母亲又一次 breaked the silence at the far table）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 break 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the grower breaked the silence at the far table at once, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower breaks the silence at the far table in the rain whenever the greenhouse asks.
Breaking the silence at the far table at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever break the old bowl on the step in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse breaks the old bowl on the step at once every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother breaked the silence at the far table again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
